Role Description The Homecare Nurse – DHA role is a full-time, on-site position based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The nurse will provide comprehensive home-based nursing care, including assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient care in accordance with DHA regulations and clinical standards. Daily responsibilities include monitoring patient conditions, administering medications, managing wound care, and coordinating with physicians and other healthcare professionals to ensure continuity of care. The role involves educating patients and families on treatment plans, home care procedures, and health maintenance, while maintaining accurate documentation and upholding patient safety and confidentiality. The nurse will also participate in care planning, respond to changes in patient status, and support a respectful, culturally sensitive home environment.
q: Candidates should possess strong Nursing and Home Care skills, with experience in providing comprehensive care in a home setting.
Candidates should possess solid Medicine and Patient Care skills, including clinical assessment, medication administration, and ongoing patient monitoring.
Candidates should possess effective Wound Care skills, including dressing changes, infection prevention, and wound healing management.
Valid DHA nursing license or eligibility for DHA licensing in Dubai.
Recognized nursing qualification (e.g., Bachelor’s or Diploma in Nursing) and current professional registration.
Previous experience in homecare or community nursing, preferably in the UAE or GCC region.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and adapt to diverse home environments.
Commitment to ethical practice, patient confidentiality, and adherence to safety and clinical guidelines.
